proposed.sourceName: Halal Food Standards Alliance of America (HFSAA) — Official Halal Standard ('About')
proposed.paraphrase: HFSAA's strict standard comfortably exceeds the lenient bar. (Accessed 2026-07-01.)

researcherNote: HFSAA = hand-slaughter (no machine), Tasmiyah each, reversible-stun-only (its own standard). Zabiha claim noted: HFSAA permits reversible stunning where necessary, but requires hand-slaughter + name on each animal, which meets the app's zabiha definition; HMC is stricter still (no stun at all). APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01 (batch pre-approval).
